notes:
Lead: CTO (Asha Mehta) very focused on predictable latency for support workflows. Started on Hosted API in Jan POC — moved to Dedicated evaluation after seeing cost opportunity and need for VPC.

POC highlights: low-latency routing to eu-us nodes; embeddings for doc-search showed 12% NPS lift in internal agent console; chat latency median 120ms with hosted dev tokens, target <= 80ms for prod — want dedicated pools to hit this.

Pricing convo summary (Mar 3 call): AE outlined three commit bands (base, growth, enterprise). Harrowgate wants: committed baseline for 4x GPU equivalent throughput, 2x burst pool, predictable overage (no surprise price spikes). They pushed back on 25% overage premium — asked for 15% capped.

Ramp/contract asks: 12 month ramp with quarterly commit step-ups (25% increments), option to increase burst capacity for seasonal events, SLA credits for latency misses. Wants early-exit protection tied to missed SLOs first 90 days.

Security: must support SSO + SCIM, SOC2 + written audit logging retention policy, KMS integration with customer-managed keys, and EU data residency for EU traffic. Legal requested a residency addendum draft.

Quotes from calls: "If we can't lock in predictable overage cap, finance won't sign" — Head of Finance. "We need clear measurable perf metrics in the SOW" — Asha (CTO).

Next actions captured: AE send revised pricing matrix with 15% overage cap scenario; SE to produce throughput/latency runbook for committed config; legal to review residency addendum template; schedule exec intro with VP of Product and Redwood CRO week of 3/15.
